entries.name: Fighter
entries.summary: A durable martial class focused on weapons, armor, and reliable combat choices.
entries.beginnerTip: A good first choice if you want a straightforward turn with room to learn tactical options later.

source.adaptation: Original short-form beginner summary; verify mechanics against the cited SRD.

entries.name: Human
entries.summary: A flexible species choice that can support many character concepts.
entries.beginnerTip: Choose the options that reinforce what you want your character to be good at.

source.adaptation: Original short-form beginner summary; no source prose reproduced.

entries.name: Attack
entries.summary: Use a weapon or another available attack during your turn.
entries.beginnerTip: Pick an attack, let the app roll it, then ask the DM whether it hits before rolling damage.

entries.name: Dodge
entries.summary: Focus on defense until the start of your next turn.
entries.beginnerTip: Useful when surviving is more important than dealing damage this turn.

source.adaptation: Original beginner summary; exact effects remain engine data.

entries.name: Initiative
entries.summary: A roll used to determine when creatures act as combat begins.
entries.beginnerTip: Tap Roll Initiative on your sheet; tell the result to the DM.

entries.name: Prone
entries.summary: A condition representing a creature being down on the ground.
entries.beginnerTip: Apply this condition and use the Why panel to see how it changes movement and attacks.
